Topic: VLA, vision-language-action robotics. Title exactly: “VLA：从观察与指令到机器人动作”. Main composition: left column shows an RGB scene of a robot gripper and a cup on a table, plus a short speech card reading “把杯子放到托盘上”, plus a small schematic joint-state dial. One large label “视觉 · 语言 · 本体状态”. These inputs converge by a single arrow into a central elegant model block labeled “动作策略”. Arrow to a sequence of 4 discrete pose silhouettes / action segments labeled “预测动作块”. Arrow to a physical robot arm placing the cup on a tray labeled “机器人执行”. Draw a clear lower return arrow from execution back to the scene/input, label “新观测反馈”. Critical meaning: show closed-loop conditioning and action prediction, not text-only response; robot arm realistic proportions, cup physically grasped, target tray distinct. Do not imply direct motor current output, universal guaranteed success, or a mandatory world model. 4 main stages with a bottom feedback loop.
specs.alt: VLA 闭环：视觉、语言和本体状态输入动作策略，预测动作块，经机器人执行后获取新观测。
specs.caption: 图：VLA 将视觉观测、语言指令与本体状态转化为动作预测；执行后获取新观测，形成持续修正的闭环。
